name: niri-actions
title: Niri Actions
description: Browse and run niri Wayland compositor IPC actions with fuzzy search. Covers window, column, workspace, monitor, screenshot and system commands. Excludes actions requiring free-form arguments.
author: curliq

commands.name: niri-actions
commands.title: Niri Actions
commands.description: Lists supported niri IPC actions with fuzzy search and runs the selected one via `niri msg action`. Actions with enumerable arguments are expanded into concrete items using live compositor state.
